name: Ch2 Combo Cult
description: In this mini-series I'm delving deeper in the Ch2 card pool for interesting combos.

decks.introMd: Here Daniela drags enemies kicking and screaming into [Lie in Wait](/card/60566) or [Rope Trap](/card/60578), getting attacks with her ability and a [Service Revolver](/card/60158) for up to 6 attacks in a round rather than the usual 5. For soaking attacks, [Bodyguard](/card/12027) takes a bullet or a tentacle for you and dishes out auto-damage.

Why have one combo, when you can have four?! Here Izzie uses [Old Compass](/card/12083) and [Rabbit's Foot](/card/60560) as fail tech, getting clues off 4 shroud locations with ["Look what I found!"](/card/12078). She gets testless clues with [Will of the Cosmos](/card/12066), and places the doom on self-discarding [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074) or [Same Old Thing](/card/60561). She heals horror and damage with [Consume Life](/card/60462) kills paired to [Cosmic Guidance](/card/60468) and [Fearless](/card/12069). Lastly, through double-dipping [Do-or-Die](/card/60568) with her ability then Izzie trivially recurs the ever-powerful [Scrape By](/card/12082). How I got this all into one deck I'll never know!
